text.p: Belgian industrial services and energy group Tractebel said on Wednesday CRSS Inc, a subsidiary of Tractebel's Powerfin SA unit, in the last 30 days completed three acquistions in North America.

CRSS, a power operation subsidiary, bought all of NEPCO, a 50 megawatt cogeneration plant in Kline Township, Pennsylvania, which sells power to Pennsylvania Power and Light Co and steam to an adjacent greenhouse operation.
The deal was worth $115 million, which included a provision to invest in streamlining the facility.

CRSS bought all of a 42 mw cogeneration facility in Ripon, California, for $57.5 million. The plant sells power to Pacific Gas and Electric Co and steam to the Simpson Paper Co. CRSS plans to expand the power generating capacity.
CRSS bought a 30 percent stake in a 110 mw, 200 million Canadian dollar cogeneration project on Ontario from Toronto-based Northland Power. The plant is to come on stream at the end of 1996.
Power will be sold to Ontario Hydro and steam to an adjacent Abitibi Print newsprint mill.
Tractebel is active in the sectors of power, gas, cable TV, water, waste management, engineering, real estate and industrial services.
